stages.title: Marginal analysis
stages.sub: Judge decisions by weighing up the extra cost and extra benefit of one more unit.

steps.q: A bakery has already spent £200 on flour, ovens and staff today. Does that £200 help decide whether to bake another batch?
steps.right: Not much, it is already spent
steps.wrong: Yes, it tells you what to do next
steps.hint: That money is spent whatever happens next. Does it change tonight's decision?
